title: Ischemic stroke with new AF, to inpatient rehab; nursing transfer instructions omit apixaban (single gap)

rationale.meds_consistent: The summary's discharge list includes apixaban 5 mg twice daily; the nursing transfer list omits it, a high-risk anticoagulant omission.
rationale.dp_evaluation: The case management note documents a discharge planning assessment of post-hospital needs (IRF level of care).
rationale.pac_list: Case management gave a list of Medicare-participating IRFs.
rationale.pac_choice: Freedom of choice was explained and the patient's chosen facility is the one he was referred to.
rationale.pac_quality_data: Care Compare quality ratings were provided with the list.
